reasoning: Recent New Hampshire Senate polling over the last 45 days shows Democrat Chris Pappas ahead of Republican John Sununu by roughly 4 to 6 points, with the latest polling average at D+5.4. Because the available recent sources are Senate-specific and state-specific, the current margin is best characterized as a modest Democratic edge; I did not find a current presidential general-election margin for New Hampshire in the provided results.

sources.name: PollsMax New Hampshire Senate Polling Average
sources.details: Aggregates 14 polls for the 2026 New Hampshire Senate race and shows a polling average of 46.7% for Pappas and 41.2% for Sununu, a D+5.4 margin.

sources.name: University of New Hampshire Survey Center via ECIKS coverage
sources.details: University of New Hampshire survey cited in coverage found Pappas leading Sununu 47% to 44%, a narrow Democratic edge.
